2	
3	## Project Overview
4	
5	This project applies **GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization)** reinforcement learning to fine-tune a **Qwen2.5-VL-7B** vision-language model for **industrial anomaly detection (IAD)**. The model is initialized from an SFT checkpoint (PA-SFT, checkpoint-2828) and trained with a custom reward function that evaluates defect detection accuracy, defect type classification, and bounding box localization.
6	
7	**Goal:** Improve test-set evaluation score through RL training on top of the SFT model.
8	
9	## Project Structure
10	
11	```
12	stage_rl_trl/
13	├── src/                              # 核心代码（只有一份）

17	│   └── rewards/
18	│       ├── __init__.py               # REWARD_REGISTRY 注册表
19	│       ├── accuracy_reward.py        # R_ans + R_cls + R_loc
20	│       ├── location_reward.py        # IoU/CIoU + 匈牙利匹配

74	## Creating New Experiments
75	
76	1. 创建 YAML: `configs/experiments/expXXX_desc.yaml`
77	2. 只写和 base 的差异:
78	```yaml
79	_parent: "configs/base.yaml"
80	training:
81	  learning_rate: 5e-7
82	reward:

84	```

88

91	| 名称 | 说明 |

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Project Overview
6	
7	**LTX Trainer** is a training toolkit for fine-tuning the Lightricks LTX audio-video generation models. It supports:
8	
9	- **LoRA training** - Efficient fine-tuning with adapters
10	- **Full fine-tuning** - Complete model training
11	- **Audio-video training** - Joint audio and video generation
12	- **IC-LoRA training** - In-context control adapters for video-to-video transformations
13	
14	**Supported model versions:**
15	
16	- **LTX-2** (19B, initial audio-video model)
17	- **LTX-2.3** (22B, improved text conditioning and audio quality)
18	
19	Version detection is fully automatic — ltx-core reads the checkpoint config and selects the correct architecture
20	components. The trainer does not need version-specific code paths.
21	
22	**Key Dependencies:**
23	
24	- **[`ltx-core`](../ltx-core/)** - Core model implementations (transformer, VAE, text encoder, scheduler)
25	- **[`ltx-pipelines`](../ltx-pipelines/)** - Inference pipeline components
26	
27	> **Important:** This trainer only supports **LTX-2 and later** (audio-video models). The older LTXV (video-only) models
28	> are not supported.
29	
30	## Architecture Overview
31	
32	### Package Structure
33

77	### Key Architectural Patterns
78	
79	**Model Loading:**
80	
81	- `ltx_trainer.model_loader` provides component loaders using `ltx-core`
82	- Individual loaders: `load_transformer()`, `load_video_vae_encoder()`, `load_video_vae_decoder()`,
83	  `load_text_encoder()`, `load_embeddings_processor()`, etc.
84	- Combined loader: `load_model()` returns `LtxModelComponents` dataclass
85	- Uses `SingleGPUModelBuilder` from ltx-core internally
86	- Text encoder and embeddings processor are loaded separately (the text encoder only needs Gemma weights; the embeddings processor only needs the LTX checkpoint)
87	- 8-bit text encoder loading via `gemma_8bit.py` (bitsandbytes)
88	
89	**Training Flow:**
90	
91	1. Configuration loaded via Pydantic models in `config.py`
92	2. `LtxvTrainer` class orchestrates the training loop
93	3. Text encoder loaded on GPU → validation embeddings cached → heavy components unloaded (only `embeddings_processor`
94	   kept)
95	4. Each training step: embedding connectors applied → strategy prepares `ModelInputs` → transformer forward pass →
96	   strategy computes loss
97	5. Training strategies (`TextToVideoStrategy`, `VideoToVideoStrategy`) handle mode-specific logic
98	6. Accelerate handles distributed training, mixed precision, and device placement
99	7. Data flows as precomputed latents through `PrecomputedDataset`
100	
101	**Model Interface (Modality-based):**
102	
103	```python
104	from ltx_core.model.transformer.modality import Modality
105	
106	video = Modality(
107	    enabled=True,
108	    latent=video_latents,  # [B, seq_len, 128] patchified latent tokens
109	    sigma=sigma,  # [B,] current noise level (per-batch)
110	    timesteps=video_timesteps,  # [B, seq_len] per-token timestep embeddings
111	    positions=video_positions,  # [B, 3, seq_len, 2] positional coordinates
112	    context=video_embeds,  # text conditioning embeddings
113	    context_mask=None,  # optional attention mask for text context
114	)
115	audio = Modality(
116	    enabled=True,
117	    latent=audio_latents,
118	    sigma=sigma,
119	    timesteps=audio_timesteps,
120	    positions=audio_positions,  # [B, 1, seq_len, 2]
121	    context=audio_embeds,
122	    context_mask=None,
123	)
124	
125	# Forward pass returns predictions for both modalities
126	video_pred, audio_pred = model(video=video, audio=audio, perturbations=None)
127	```
128	
129	> **Note:** `Modality` is immutable (frozen dataclass). Use `dataclasses.replace()` to modify.
130	
131	**`sigma` vs `timesteps`:** These serve different roles. `timesteps` is per-token (e.g. `sigma * denoise_mask` —
132	conditioning tokens get 0, noisy tokens get sigma). `sigma` is per-batch and is used for prompt AdaLN conditioning (
133	LTX-2.3) and cross-modality (video↔audio) attention conditioning (both versions).
134	
135	**Configuration System:**
136	
137	- All config in `src/ltx_trainer/config.py`
138	- Main class: `LtxTrainerConfig`
139	- Training strategy configs: `TextToVideoConfig`, `VideoToVideoConfig`
140	- Uses Pydantic field validators and model validators
141	- Config uses `extra="forbid"` — unknown fields cause validation errors
142	- Config files in `configs/` directory

144	## LTX-2 vs LTX-2.3: Differences
145	
146	Both model versions share the same latent space interface (see [Latent Space Constants](#latent-space-constants)).
147	The differences lie in how text conditioning and audio generation work. Version detection is automatic via checkpoint
148	config — the trainer uses a unified API.
149	
150	| Component             | LTX-2 (19B)                                                                     | LTX-2.3 (22B)                                                                                       |
151	|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
152	| Feature extractor     | `FeatureExtractorV1`: single `aggregate_embed`, same output for video and audio | `FeatureExtractorV2`: separate `video_aggregate_embed` + `audio_aggregate_embed`, per-token RMSNorm |
153	| Caption projection    | Inside the transformer (`caption_projection`)                                   | Inside the feature extractor (before connector)                                                     |
154	| Embeddings connectors | Same dimensions for video and audio                                             | Separate dimensions (`AudioEmbeddings1DConnectorConfigurator`)                                      |
155	| Prompt AdaLN          | Not present (`cross_attention_adaln=False`)                                     | Active — modulates cross-attention to text using `sigma`                                            |
156	| Vocoder               | HiFi-GAN (`Vocoder`)                                                            | BigVGAN v2 + bandwidth extension (`VocoderWithBWE`)                                                 |
157	
158	**How version detection works in ltx-core:**
159	
160	- **Feature extractor:** `_create_feature_extractor()` checks for V2 config keys (`caption_proj_before_connector`,
161	  etc.). Present → V2; absent → V1.
162	- **Vocoder:** `VocoderConfigurator` checks for `config["vocoder"]["bwe"]`. Present → `VocoderWithBWE`; absent →
163	  `Vocoder`.
164	- **Transformer:** `_build_caption_projections()` checks `caption_proj_before_connector`. True (V2) → no caption
165	  projection in transformer; False (V1) → caption projection created in transformer.
166	- **Embeddings connectors:** `AudioEmbeddings1DConnectorConfigurator` reads `audio_connector_*` keys, falling back to
167	  video connector keys for V1 backward compatibility.
168	
169	## Text Encoder Pipeline
170	
171	The `GemmaTextEncoder` implements a 3-block pipeline:
172	
173	1. **Block 1 — Gemma LLM:** Tokenizes text → runs through Gemma → extracts hidden states
174	2. **Block 2 — Feature extractor:** Hidden states → normalized features (V1: single stream duplicated for video/audio;
175	   V2: separate video and audio projections)
176	3. **Block 3 — Embeddings processor:** Features → embeddings connectors → final context embeddings for the transformer
177	
178	**Precomputed embeddings (offline):** `process_captions.py` runs Blocks 1+2 via `text_encoder.precompute()` and saves
179	the results. Block 3 (connectors) is applied during training via
180	`text_encoder.embeddings_processor.create_embeddings()`.
181	
182	**Precomputed embeddings formats:**
183	
184	- **New format** (from `precompute()`): saves `video_prompt_embeds`, `audio_prompt_embeds` (optional),
185	  `prompt_attention_mask`
186	- **Legacy format** (from old `_preprocess_text()`): saves `prompt_embeds`, `prompt_attention_mask`
187	
188	The trainer handles both formats in `_training_step()`: if `video_prompt_embeds` is present, it uses the new format;
189	otherwise, it duplicates `prompt_embeds` for both modalities (mirroring V1 behavior).
190	
191	**After caching validation embeddings**, the trainer unloads heavy components to free VRAM:
192	
193	```python
194	self._text_encoder.model = None
195	self._text_encoder.tokenizer = None
196	self._text_encoder.feature_extractor = None
197	# Only embeddings_processor (connectors) remains — used during training
198	```

201	
202	These values are shared across all supported model versions:
203	
204	| Constant                     | Value                            | Where used                                                |
205	|------------------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
206	| Video latent channels        | 128                              | VAE encoder/decoder, patchifier, `VideoLatentShape`       |
207	| Spatial compression          | 32× (H and W)                    | `SpatioTemporalScaleFactors.default()`, config validators |
208	| Temporal compression         | 8×                               | `SpatioTemporalScaleFactors.default()`, config validators |
209	| Frame constraint             | `frames % 8 == 1`                | Config validators, validation sampler                     |
210	| Resolution constraint        | Width and height divisible by 32 | Config validators, validation sampler                     |
211	| Audio latent channels        | 8                                | `AudioLatentShape`, audio patchifier                      |
212	| Audio mel bins               | 16                               | `AudioLatentShape`, audio patchifier                      |
213	| Patchified token dim (video) | 128 (`128 × 1 × 1 × 1`)          | Transformer `in_channels`                                 |
214	| Patchified token dim (audio) | 128 (`8 × 16`)                   | Transformer `audio_in_channels`                           |

1	# batch_download_v4.py — 安全的 --retry-downloading 重设计
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	v3 的 `--retry-downloading` 功能存在多个相互关联的 bug，导致 Ctrl+C 时 state 文件被截断损毁、
6	队列包含不相关的电影、movie_key 格式不匹配等连锁问题。需要从根本上重新设计。
7	
8	## 核心改动（5 项）
9	
10	### 1. 原子写入 `save_state`（防 Ctrl+C 损坏）
11	
12	```python
13	def save_state(state):
14	    tmp = STATE_FILE + ".tmp"
15	    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
16	        json.dump(state, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
17	    os.replace(tmp, STATE_FILE)  # 原子操作，写完才替换
18	```
19	
20	### 2. 操作前自动备份（安全网）
21	
22	任何 `--retry-*` 操作执行前，先拷贝当前 state 到 `download_state.json.bak`：
23	
24	```python
25	import shutil
26	def backup_state():
27	    if os.path.exists(STATE_FILE):
28	        bak = STATE_FILE + ".bak"
29	        shutil.copy2(STATE_FILE, bak)
30	        print(f"  [备份] {os.path.basename(bak)}")
31	```
32	
33	### 3. `--retry-downloading` 绕过 `load_magnets`，直接从 state 构建队列
34	
35	**核心思路：不去扫描所有 JSON 文件，而是从 state 里精确提取 downloading 条目，
36	再到 JSON 文件中只查找这些电影的 magnet 数据。**
37	
38	```python
39	def collect_downloading_targets(state):
40	    """从 state 收集所有 downloading 的电影标题（不修改 state）"""
41	    titles = set()
42	    for mk, v in state.get("movies", {}).items():
43	        if v.get("status") == "downloading":
44	            # 兼容 {idx}_{title} 和纯 title 两种 key 格式
45	            parts = mk.split("_", 1)
46	            title = parts[1] if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() else mk
47	            titles.add(title)
48	    return titles
49	
50	def build_retry_entries(state, target_titles):
51	    """只为 target_titles 中的电影构建 entries（不扫描无关电影）"""
52	    entries = []
53	    seen = set()
54	    failed_hashes = set(h for h, v in state.get("links", {}).items()
55	                        if v.get("status") == "failed")
56	
57	    json_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(MAGNETS_DIR, "*.json")))
58	    json_files = [f for f in json_files if os.path.basename(f) not in {"seen_videos.json"}]
59	
60	    for fpath in json_files:
61	        data = json.load(open(fpath, encoding="utf-8"))
62	        for item in data:
63	            if not isinstance(item, dict): continue
64	            title = item.get("title", "unknown")
65	            if title not in target_titles or title in seen:
66	                continue
67	
68	            magnets = item.get("magnets") or ([item["magnet"]] if "magnet" in item else [])
69	            if not magnets: continue
70	
71	            # 找第一个未失败的链接
72	            start_idx = None
73	            for i, mag in enumerate(magnets):
74	                if get_hash(mag) not in failed_hashes:
75	                    start_idx = i
76	                    break
77	
78	            if start_idx is not None:
79	                # 优先选链接最多的版本（不马上 add seen，让后续文件有机会提供更多链接）
80	                existing = next((e for e in entries if e["title"] == title), None)
81	                if existing and len(magnets) > len(existing["magnets"]):
82	                    entries.remove(existing)
83	                elif existing:
84	                    continue
85	                entries.append({
86	                    "title": title, "magnets": magnets, "magnet_idx": start_idx,
87	                    "index": item.get("index", 0), "movie_key": title,
88	                    "source_file": os.path.basename(fpath), "year": item.get("year", 0),
89	                })
90	                seen.add(title)
91	
92	    return entries
93	```
94	
95	### 4. `retry_downloading` 重写：先收集目标，再精确重置
96	
97	```python
98	def retry_downloading(state):
99	    # 第一步：收集目标标题（只读，不改 state）
100	    target_titles = collect_downloading_targets(state)
101	    if not target_titles:
102	        print("  [retry-downloading] 没有找到 downloading 状态的电影")
103	        return []
104	
105	    # 第二步：只重置这些目标的 links 和 movies
106	    links = state.get("links", {})
107	    reset_links = 0
108	    for h, v in links.items():
109	        if v.get("status") == "downloading" and v.get("title", "") in target_titles:
110	            v["status"] = "pending"
111	            reset_links += 1
112	
113	    movies = state.get("movies", {})
114	    reset_movies = 0
115	    for mk, v in list(movies.items()):
116	        if v.get("status") != "downloading": continue
117	        parts = mk.split("_", 1)
118	        title = parts[1] if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() else mk
119	        if title in target_titles:
120	            v["status"] = "pending"
121	            v.pop("fail_reason", None)
122	            reset_movies += 1
123	
124	    save_state(state)
125	    print(f"  [retry-downloading] 重置 {reset_links} 个链接，{reset_movies} 部电影 → pending")
126	    print(f"  [retry-downloading] 目标: {len(target_titles)} 部电影")
127	
128	    # 第三步：构建精确的 entries
129	    entries = build_retry_entries(state, target_titles)
130	    print(f"  [retry-downloading] 在 JSON 中找到 {len(entries)}/{len(target_titles)} 部的可用链接")
131	
132	    return entries  # 直接返回 entries，main() 直接用，不走 load_magnets
133	```
134	
135	### 5. `main()` 中的 retry-downloading 路径独立
136	
137	```python
138	# 在 main() 中：
139	if retry_dl_mode:
140	    backup_state()
141	    entries = retry_downloading(state)  # 返回精确的 entries
142	    pending = entries
143	else:
144	    if retry_mode:
145	        backup_state()
146	        retry_failed(state)
147	    entries = load_magnets(state, extra_json=extra_json)
148	    pending = entries
149	```
150	
151	## 附带修复
152	
153	- `save_state` 改为原子写入（影响全局，所有模式受益）
154	- `all_failed_count` 在 while 循环前初始化
155	- `load_magnets` 中 `seen_movies.add(mk)` 移到 `entries.append` 之后（已在 v3 中修复，保留）
156	
157	## 文件
158	
159	- 创建 `/nvmedata/workspace2/users/sss/batch_download_v4.py`（从 v3 复制后修改）
160	- v3 保持不动
161	
162	## 验证步骤
163	
164	1. 先让当前 `--retry-failed` 跑一会积累一些 downloading 状态的条目
165	2. Ctrl+C 中断
166	3. 运行 `python3 batch_download_v4.py --retry-downloading 3`
167	4. 确认：
168	   - state 文件备份到 `.bak`
169	   - 只有之前 downloading 的电影被加入队列（不是 500+）
170	   - Ctrl+C 后 state 文件不会损坏（原子写入）

1	# Plan: v06 - 固定帧数切分子片段
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	用户处理完整电影文件，需要把每个无切镜场景段按 96 帧为单位切成多个等长 clip。不足 96 帧的尾巴拼到最后一个 clip（而不是丢弃）。当前 v05 只能整段导出，不支持固定帧数分割。
6	
7	## 目标文件
8	
9	基于 v05 创建新版本：
10	- 原文件: `/nvmedata/workspace2/users/sss/数据预处理/切镜判断/precise_cut并发_查log+过滤开头结尾_20260331_v05_OpenCV不跑整集仅候选片段补检.py`
11	- 新文件: `/nvmedata/workspace2/users/sss/数据预处理/切镜判断/precise_cut并发_查log+过滤开头结尾_20260401_v06_固定帧数切分.py`
12	
13	## 核心改动
14	
15	### 1. 新增参数 `--fixed-clip-frames`（默认 96）
16	
17	在 `RuntimeConfig` 新增字段 `fixed_clip_frames: int`，在 `parse_args` 中新增 `--fixed-clip-frames` 参数。
18	
19	### 2. 修改 `build_segments` 函数（核心逻辑）
20	
21	当前逻辑：每个切点间隔 → 1 个 segment。
22	
23	新逻辑：每个切点间隔 → 按 `fixed_clip_frames` 拆分成 N 个 sub-clip segment：
24	- `total_frames = raw_duration * fps`
25	- 若 `total_frames < min_segment_frames (96)`：跳过（已有逻辑）
26	- 若 `fixed_clip_frames <= 0`：不拆分，保持原行为
27	- 否则：
28	  - `n_clips = max(1, floor(total_frames / fixed_clip_frames))`
29	  - 前 `n_clips - 1` 个 clip：精确 `fixed_clip_frames / fps` 秒
30	  - 最后一个 clip：剩余所有帧（`>= fixed_clip_frames`，可能到 `2 * fixed_clip_frames - 1`）
31	  - 每个 sub-clip 作为独立 segment 条目写入 manifest
32	
33	示例（fps=25, fixed_clip_frames=96）：
34	- 场景段 300 帧 → 3 clips: 96帧 + 96帧 + 108帧
35	- 场景段 191 帧 → 1 clip: 191帧
36	- 场景段 192 帧 → 2 clips: 96帧 + 96帧
37	
38	### 3. segment_id 命名
39	
40	拍平编号：所有 sub-clip 统一按全局递增序号命名 `seg00001`, `seg00002`, ...。文件名保持 `{video_stem}_seg{N:05d}.mp4`。无需引入层级命名。
41	
42	### 4. 更新文档头/版本标识
43	
44	- `CURRENT_SCRIPT_VERSION` 更新
45	- 文件头 docstring 更新
46	
47	## 不变的部分
48	
49	- 切镜检测逻辑（ffmpeg + OpenCV）不变
50	- 导出逻辑（`export_segment`）不变——仍用 trim + 重编码
51	- 复检逻辑（`verify_export_clean`）不变
52	- 断点重跑机制不变
53	- 其他所有参数不变
54	
55	## 验证方式
56	
57	```bash
58	# dry-run 验证 segment 拆分是否正确
59	python .../v06_固定帧数切分.py \
60	  --input-root <INPUT> \
61	  --output-root <OUTPUT> \
62	  --fixed-clip-frames 96 \
63	  --dry-run
64	```
65	
66	检查 manifest JSON 中 segments 列表：每个 segment 的 `raw_duration * fps` 应 >= 96，且除最后一个外应精确等于 96 帧对应的秒数。

1	# CLAUDE.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Project Overview
6	
7	BAGEL is a unified multimodal foundation model (7B active / 14B total parameters) from ByteDance that performs both visual understanding (VLM) and image generation (T2I). It uses a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts (MoT) architecture.
8	
9	## Setup
10	
11	```bash
12	conda create -n bagel python=3.10 -y
13	conda activate bagel
14	pip install -r requirements.txt
15	pip install flash_attn==2.5.8 --no-build-isolation
16	```
17	
18	## Common Commands
19	
20	### Training
21	```bash
22	bash scripts/train.sh
23	```
24	Multi-node training uses `torchrun` with FSDP. Key arguments: `--nnodes`, `--node_rank`, `--nproc_per_node`, `--master_addr`, `--master_port`.
25	
26	### Evaluation
27	```bash
28	# VLM benchmarks (MME, MMBench, MMMU, MMVet, MathVista)
29	bash scripts/eval/run_eval_vlm.sh
30	
31	# GenEval (text-to-image)
32	bash scripts/eval/run_geneval.sh
33	
34	# WISE benchmark
35	bash scripts/eval/run_wise.sh
36	
37	# Image editing benchmarks
38	bash scripts/eval/run_gedit.sh     # GEdit-Bench
39	bash scripts/eval/run_imgedit.sh   # ImgEdit-Bench
40	bash scripts/eval/run_kris.sh      # KRIS-Bench
41	bash scripts/eval/run_rise.sh      # RISEBench
42	```
43	
44	### Inference (Gradio WebUI)
45	```bash
46	# 32GB+ VRAM
47	python app.py
48	
49	# 12-32GB VRAM with NF4 quantization
50	python app.py --mode 2

1	<!--
2	MAINTENANCE: When modifying any pipeline class in src/ltx_pipelines/,
3	update this document to reflect changes to:
4	- __init__ / __call__ signatures
5	- sigma handling or step counts
6	- denoiser types or guidance
7	- new or removed pipelines
8	Run: ls src/ltx_pipelines/*.py to check for new pipeline files.
9	-->
10	
11	# ltx-pipelines
12	
13	Inference pipelines for LTX-2 audio-video generation. Depends on `ltx-core` for model definitions, diffusion components, and loading. All pipelines live in `packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/`.
14	
15	## Pipeline selection
16	
17	| Pipeline | File | Stages | Model | Sampler | Use case |
18	|----------|------|--------|-------|---------|----------|
19	| `TI2VidOneStagePipeline` | `ti2vid_one_stage.py` | 1 | Full | Euler | Simple text/image-to-video |
20	| `TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline` | `ti2vid_two_stages.py` | 2 | Full + distilled LoRA | Euler | Production quality |
21	| `TI2VidTwoStagesHQPipeline` | `ti2vid_two_stages_hq.py` | 2 | Full + distilled LoRA (both stages) | Res2s | Highest quality, fewer steps |
22	| `A2VidPipelineTwoStage` | `a2vid_two_stage.py` | 2 | Full + distilled LoRA | Euler | Audio-conditioned video |
23	| `KeyframeInterpolationPipeline` | `keyframe_interpolation.py` | 2 | Full + distilled LoRA | Euler | Keyframe interpolation |
24	| `DistilledPipeline` | `distilled.py` | 2 | Distilled only | Euler | Fastest inference |
25	| `ICLoraPipeline` | `ic_lora.py` | 2 | Distilled only | Euler | Video-to-video with IC-LoRA control |
26	| `RetakePipeline` | `retake.py` | 1 | Full or distilled | Euler | Video region regeneration |
27	
28	## Guidance
29	
30	- **CFG**: Blends conditioned/unconditioned predictions. Defaults: `cfg_scale=3.0` (video), `7.0` (audio).

1	# Experiment Rules & Protocols
2	
3	## 1. Experiment Lifecycle
4	
5	Every experiment follows this cycle:
6	
7	```
8	Analysis → Design → Run → Results Analysis → Paper Analysis → Next Experiment
9	```
10	
11	### Phase 1: Analysis (Before Experiment)
12	- [ ] Read EXPERIMENT_LOG.md for current state and prior findings
13	- [ ] Identify the specific question this experiment answers
14	- [ ] Define metrics: what do we measure, what is success?
15	- [ ] Check GPU availability (target: 1-2 GPUs per experiment)
16	- [ ] Verify dataset and model paths exist
17	
18	### Phase 2: Design
19	- [ ] Write experiment entry in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md (before starting)
20	- [ ] Define exact hyperparameter changes (diff from baseline)
21	- [ ] Create/modify shell script with naming convention
22	- [ ] Estimate training time
23	- [ ] Set up checkpoint resume logic
24	
25	### Phase 3: Run
26	- [ ] Start training with `nohup` and log to output_dir
27	- [ ] Verify training starts correctly (check first 10 steps in log)
28	- [ ] Monitor reward trend in first 50 steps
29	- [ ] Record GPU allocation in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md
30	
31	### Phase 4: Results Analysis
32	- [ ] Extract final metrics from train.log
33	- [ ] Compare with baseline on same metrics
34	- [ ] Plot reward curves (if tensorboard data available)
35	- [ ] Check for training instabilities (loss spikes, KL explosion, grad_norm anomalies)
36	- [ ] Document findings in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md
37	
38	### Phase 5: Paper Analysis
39	- [ ] Relate findings to relevant papers (GRPO, DAPO, RL for VLMs)
40	- [ ] Identify which design decisions helped/hurt
41	- [ ] Plan next experiment based on insights
42
